outcome: psychometric properties of CZ-MPSS (internal consistency, factor structure, divergent validity)
cohort: The study included 478 Czech-speaking women up to 12 months after childbirth, with a mean age of 31.2 years.
finding: The Czech translated Maternal Postpartum Stress Scale (CZ-MPSS) is a reliable, valid, and clinically sensitive measure of postpartum stress for Czech mothers, with an exploratory nine-factor solution providing an excellent fit to the data.
mod_finding: Total stress was modestly higher in mothers after an emergency cesarean section.
